title: Static methods in parent and child classes
answer: Static methods are hidden, not overridden. The method selected depends on the class name used or the declared type of the reference at compile time, not on the runtime object. AeroTopo defines `Product.category()` and `Orthomosaic.category()` with the same signature. `Product.category()` returns the parent value, while `Orthomosaic.category()` returns the child value; runtime polymorphic dispatch does not choose between them.
